content:
jess: Customer (Acme) flagged a huge embedding usage spike yesterday — charts show ~1.2M units for the day but their account activity and billing delta look normal. Screenshot attached. 😬

raj: Can you paste the account id and the timeframe? I'll check the raw events in the embed-meter topic.

jess: account_id: ACME-9987. Spike window: 2024-03-05 00:00-04:00 UTC. I see invoice showing ~200K billed units for the period. Chart shows 1.2M.

raj: pulling events now. quick query I ran on the metering dataset: 
```
SELECT event_type, sum(value) as total, count(distinct request_id) as requests
FROM embed_metering.events
WHERE account_id='ACME-9987' AND event_time BETWEEN '2024-03-05' AND '2024-03-06'
GROUP BY event_type;
```

raj: result looks odd — two event types for embeddings present: `embedding.vectors` and `embedding.vectors_batched`. Both have counts that sum to the inflated value.

ash: hmm, we added `vectors_batched` in the agent v2 to capture per-input vector counts for multi-input requests. Backend telemetry emits both `vectors` (legacy per-request) and `vectors_batched` (per-input) for the same request when a new client-side batching flag is used. Rollup job was summing all event types indiscriminately.

marta: that would explain the billing mismatch — billing uses normalized `metering_units` deduped by request_id, but the analytics chart sums event.value by event_type without dedup.

jess: do we have a reproducible curl to show the double emission? I'll send to Acme if needed.

raj: repro steps below (quick):
1) send embeddings request with multiple inputs (n=3) to /v1/embeddings with client batching flag `x-client-batched: true`
2) observe two metering events emitted to kafka for the same request_id

Example request:
```
POST /v1/embeddings
Authorization: Bearer <key>
Content-Type: application/json
x-client-batched: true
{
  "model": "text-embed-3-large",
  "input": ["a","b","c"],
  "request_id": "req-12345"
}
```

Observed events (simplified):
```
{ "request_id": "req-12345", "event_type": "embedding.vectors", "value": 3 }
{ "request_id": "req-12345", "event_type": "embedding.vectors_batched", "value": 3 }
```

raj: because the analytics rollup aggregates by day and sums `value` across event_type, this request contributed 6 to the day count. Multiply by thousands of batched requests => the 6x spike.

mike: timeline/impact: looks like agent v2 rolled out to a subset of hosts on 2024-03-01. Only customers using the new client batching flag will be affected. Acme does use that flag (confirmed).

ash: short-term mitigation: modify the rollup query to dedupe by `request_id` and prefer the `_batched` variant (or map both to a single canonical unit) — easy hotfix for charts. Long-term: change agent to emit a single canonical unit or include `unit_family` and `unit_kind` fields to make aggregation robust.

raj: I pushed a temporary dashboard query patch that dedupes by request_id for the last 7 days — should reduce the visible spike within ~5m after the next rollup run.

jess: thanks — I'll let Acme know we're triaging and will roll out a dashboard fix soon. Please add a billing check so we don't accidentally credit/charge while charts are different.

marta: billing pipeline unaffected (it already dedupes). I'll still run a sanity check on the accounts flagged and confirm no billing anomalies.

ash: owner: eng-analytics (raj) for the immediate rollup change. eng-runtime (ash) to follow up and update agent v2 emit contract. ETA: rollup fix in 2 hours, agent change targeted for next week.

raj: posting the patch link: https://git.redwood/eng-analytics/patches/embeds-dedupe-1712 (internal).

ingest-bot: consumer offset reset event detected on 2024-03-02 03:17 UTC for topic embed-metering; replays may have doubled events for some partitions — correlates with agent v2 rollout window.

mike: note for postmortem: please capture how many requests contained both events vs just one, and whether other metric types (e.g., `embedding.tokens`) were similarly duplicated.

jess: copying Acme support message back to thread: "Appreciate fast response — will wait for dashboard fix and let us know when it's safe to close." :thumbsup:

raj: will update in this thread when the rollup job completes.

ash: created follow-up ticket to standardize unit names and add `unit_family` to events: REDWOOD-4567.

raj: rollup patch deployed, dashboards should show corrected numbers in ~10m.

jess: confirmed from Acme — chart dropped to expected range. Closing after Marta confirms billing. Thanks everyone :rocket:
